llm_request: Social media release: On November 30, 2023, the Longport Police Department, along with the Philadelphia Flyers, organized an ice hockey event. The event including an opening game between the Atlantic County Police & Fire and the Philadelphia Police Department which was held prior to the Flyers vs Devils game. The Atlantic County team, led by Longport Patrolman Alec Morelli and organizer of the event, were victorious in this charitable and friendly competition 6 -3. The Longport police department would like to thank all those who donated and helped make this event reality. Because of the efforts of so many, all money raised will be donated to the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia. Following the conclusion of the First Responders game between Atlantic County and Philadelphia PD, Ofc Morelli dedicated the evening to Gwen Stern who lost her husband in a tragic incident within the Borough of Longport. The Longport Police Department would like to thank the Philadelphia Flyers, the Philadelphia Police Department, and our community members for being a part of something bigger than all of us.
llm_response:
Here are a few ways to adapt this release for different platforms. 

### Option 1: Facebook / Nextdoor (Detailed & Community-Focused)
**Goal:** Tell the full story, highlight the charity, and tag relevant organizations.

**[Suggested Image: A photo of the Atlantic County team holding a check, Officer Morelli on the ice, or a group photo with the Flyers/Philadelphia PD.]**

**Post:**
A huge win for our community and for a great cause! 🏒️❤️

On November 30, 2023, the Longport Police Department partnered with the Philadelphia Flyers to host an incredible charity ice hockey event. The night kicked off with a thrilling First Responders game between Atlantic County Police & Fire and the Philadelphia Police Department. 

Led by Longport Patrolman Alec Morelli—who also organized the entire event—our Atlantic County team secured a 6-3 victory in this friendly but fierce competition! 🥇

Following the game, Ofc. Morelli took a moment to dedicate the evening to Gwen Stern, who lost her husband in a tragic incident within the Borough of Longport. Our thoughts remain with her. 🕊️

Thanks to the incredible efforts of everyone who donated, volunteered, and cheered from the stands, ALL money raised from this event will be donated directly to the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP). 🏥✨

The Longport Police Department would like to extend our deepest gratitude to the @Philadelphia Flyers, the @Philadelphia Police Department, and our amazing community members. Thank you for being a part of something bigger than all of us! 🚔💙

#LongportPD #PhiladelphiaFlyers #CHOP #FirstResponders #CommunityFirst #CharityHockey

***

### Option 2: Instagram (Visual & Punchy)
**Goal:** Focus heavily on the photos, keeping the text slightly shorter while maintaining the emotional impact.

**[Suggested Images: A carousel of photos—Officer Morelli on the ice, the scoreboard, a handshake with Philadelphia PD, and a photo with the Flyers.]**

**Caption:**
Hockey, Heart, and Community. 🏒💙🚔

On Nov 30, Longport PD teamed up with the @NHLFlyers for a charity hockey event we won’t forget! The Atlantic County Police & Fire team—led by Longport Patrolman Alec Morelli—took home a 6-3 win against the @PhillyPolice in an epic First Responders matchup. 

During the event, Ofc. Morelli dedicated the evening to Gwen Stern, honoring her late husband. 🕊️

Because of the generosity of our community, all proceeds from the night are being donated to the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (@ChildrensPhila)! 🏥✨

Thank you to the Flyers, the Philadelphia PD, and everyone who made this possible. We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves. 

#LongportPD #Flyers #NHL #CHOP #FirstRespondersHockey #ThinBlueLine #CommunityOutreach #CharityEvent

***

### Option 3: X (formerly Twitter) / Thread (Short & Impactful)
**Goal:** Get straight to the point, utilizing hashtags and mentions. 

**Tweet 1:**
Big win for a great cause! 🏒️🏆 On Nov 30, Longport PD & the @NHLFlyers hosted a charity hockey game. Led by Longport Patrolman Alec Morelli, Atlantic County Police & Fire beat the @PhillyPolice 6-3! All money raised goes to @ChildrensPhila. 🏥👇🏼 1/2

**Tweet 2:**
During the event, Ofc. Morelli dedicated the evening to Gwen Stern, who lost her husband in a tragic incident in Longport. 🕊️ Thank you to the Flyers, Philly PD, and our community for making this possible and being part of something bigger than all of us! 🚔💙 2/2

***

### Option 4: LinkedIn (Professional & Network-Focused)
**Post:**
We are incredibly proud to share the success of a recent community outreach event organized by the Longport Police Department. 

On November 30, 2023, we partnered with the Philadelphia Flyers to host a charity ice hockey event. The evening began with a highly competitive game between Atlantic County Police & Fire and the Philadelphia Police Department. Under the leadership of Longport Patrolman Alec Morelli, the Atlantic County team secured a 6-3 victory. 

Following the game, Ofc. Morelli beautifully dedicated the evening to Gwen Stern, honoring the memory of her late husband. 

Through the collaborative efforts of our donors, volunteers, and partners, 100% of the funds raised will be donated to the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP). 

The Longport Police Department extends our sincere thanks to the Philadelphia Flyers, the Philadelphia Police Department, and our community members for demonstrating the power of partnership and being part of something bigger than ourselves. 

#CommunityOutreach #LawEnforcement #Philanthropy #ChildrensHospitalOfPhiladelphia #Partnership #FirstResponders
